gloss: to pass down (a story) by word of mouth; to hand down orally

definitions.gloss: to pass down by word of mouth; to hand down orally through generations
definitions.explanation: To transmit stories, legends, history, or traditions by telling them from one generation to the next. Emphasizes the oral nature of the transmission.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれてきた。
examples.english: This legend has been passed down through the ages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ。
examples.english: To pass down wartime experiences to the next generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれた⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、いつか⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたい→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to someday pass on to my own children the old tales that were handed down from my grandmother.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ (to tell/narrate) + ⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧ (to succeed/carry on). The ⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧ component adds the meaning of continuation across time or generations. Often used in the passive form {語|かた}り{継|つ}がれる to emphasize that something has been passed down.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語|かた}り{継|つ}がれる⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧: a legend passed down through generations
- {後世|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ: to pass down to posterity
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ: to pass on to the next generation
- {語|かた}り{継|つ}がれてきた⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧: history that has been handed down orally

USAGE:
Frequently appears in contexts about cultural heritage, war memories, folklore, and traditions. The passive form {語|かた}り{継|つ}がれる is particularly common. Carries a somewhat literary or elevated tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey/transmit — more general, not limited to oral tradition
- {言|い}い{伝|つた}える: to pass on by word of mouth — similar but less literary
